title: avoid select except long lists
name: Avoid select except long lists — GOLD
rule: Avoid select except long lists — selects hide content, are inconsistent across devices, and are hard for low digital literacy. Small lists (e.g. Australian state/territory) → radios / checkboxes / text. Long lists (e.g. country) may trade usability for compactness. Dual-cite GOV.UK / USWDS / NSW cutoffs; no house number.
pass_when: Short lists use radios/checkboxes/text; select is reserved for long lists (e.g. country). Dual-cite cutoff schools are not collapsed into a house N.
fail_when: A short list (e.g. state/territory) is a select; or a house numeric cutoff is invented as GOLD.
overview: Reserve select for long lists; use radios, checkboxes, or text for short ones.
apply_when: Choosing controls for short versus long option lists.
not_when: Inventing a house numeric cutoff claimed as GOLD.
agent_hint: Use radios/checkboxes/text for short lists; select only for long lists.
description: Avoid select except for long lists — selects hide content, vary across devices, and hurt low digital literacy. Short lists (for example Australian state/territory) should use radios, checkboxes, or text; long lists (for example country) may trade usability for compactness. Pass when short lists avoid select and select is reserved for long lists; fail when a short list is a select or a numeric cutoff is invented as GOLD.
do_not_claim: A house “use select above N options”; NL `<select multiple>` ban as this single-select usage row.
